mapper.sql: SELECT SDV.ID, SDV.CREATOR, SDV.CREATE_TIME, SDV.MODIFIER, SDV.MODIFY_TIME, SDV.LOGIC_DEL, SDV.REC_VER, SDV.BUILD_IN, SDV.TENANT_ID, SDV.KEY_ID, SDV.DICT_KEY, SDV.VALUE_NAME, SDV.VALUE, SDV.ORDER_NUM, SDV.IS_DEFAULT, SDV.I18N, SDV.CSS_STYLE, SDV.STATUS, SDV.REMARK FROM sys_dict_value SDV

SELECT DV.ID, DV.REC_VER, DV.CREATE_TIME, DV.DICT_KEY, DV.VALUE_NAME, DV.VALUE, DV.ORDER_NUM, DV.IS_DEFAULT, DV.I18N, DV.CSS_STYLE, DV.STATUS, DV.REMARK
FROM sys_dict_key DK LEFT JOIN sys_dict_value DV ON DK.ID = DV.KEY_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT ID, CREATOR, CREATE_TIME, MODIFIER, MODIFY_TIME, LOGIC_DEL, REC_VER, BUILD_IN, TENANT_ID, KEY_ID, DICT_KEY, VALUE_NAME, VALUE, ORDER_NUM, IS_DEFAULT, I18N, CSS_STYLE, STATUS, REMARK FROM sys_dict_value DV WHERE 1=1 AND LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND DICT_KEY = #{dictKey} AND KEY_ID = #{keyId}
#{dictValueName}
SELECT MAX(ORDER_NUM) FROM sys_dict_value SDV WHERE 1 = 1 AND SDV.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND SDV.KEY_ID = #{keyId} GROUP BY SDV.KEY_ID
WHERE 1=1 AND SDV.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND SDV.KEY_ID = #{keyId} AND SDV.IS_DEFAULT = 1
